content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in South Bend

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review the specific combination of formal education and hours leading projects or supporting project teams that PMI requires before you apply.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our expert instructors guide you through the PMBOK Guide and real-world scenarios over the required formal education hours, preparing you thoroughly for application and exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your boot camp, submit your PMP application directly to PMI and pay the credential exam fee. We'll guide you through the online process and help you gather the documentation PMI requires for verification.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and study materials to reinforce your boot camp learning. Schedule your proctored PMP exam with Pearson VUE when you feel ready, and we remain available for last-minute review support.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) across PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses and resources that count toward your annual PDU requirement.
